text.p: HealthSouth Corp is comfortable with analysts' earnings per share estimates of around $1.48 for 1996, Treasurer Michael Martin said Monday.
Speaking to Reuters at a Smith Barney Healthcare Conference in New York, Martin said the company expected to release fourth quarter and year-end results during the week of February 24.
According to First Call, the consensus estimates for 1996 earnings is $1.47 per share.
Speaking to the conference, HealthSouth Chief Executive Richard Scrushy said the company was set to complete its merger with Health Images Inc in the current quarter.
He reiterated that the acquisition of the diagnostic X-ray and radiology services company would be accretive to 1997 earnings.

Addressing analysts' concerns after the presentation, Scrushy said that only about one-third of the company was related to Medicare and Medicaid, about half of which was through rehabilitation hospitals. He said that consequently, the company would not be greatly affected by potential reform in this area.
